description.narrative: Novacare Hospitals Private Ltd. (Novacare or the Company) is setting up a 250-bed greenfield tertiary care hospital along with two feeder clinics in Islamabad, Pakistan for providing quality healthcare services for a range of specialties to the local population. The Project will benefit with strong technical partnerships and co-developers to ensure its design and operations meet high quality service standards thus responding to a substantial gap in the Pakistan healthcare market.

The Project is anticipated to yield significant outcomes based on improved access to quality healthcare services in Pakistan. The Project supports the construction of a tertiary-care hospital in Pakistan, which contributes to alleviating the burden of communicable and non-communicable diseases for patients and create direct and indirect job opportunities, including for medical professionals. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that this investment will promote competitiveness in the private healthcare market by demonstrating strategic engagement to improve quality of care through cutting edge clinical practices; and leveraging artificial intelligence and digital platforms for better patient satisfaction and capacity development of medical personnel.
